name: Reading
blurb: Read everyone you follow in one calm feed, and narrow it to the lists you already keep on Bluesky and Mastodon.

name: Posting
blurb: Write once and share to Bluesky, X, LinkedIn and Mastodon, then keep up with the replies in one place.

name: Conversations
blurb: Keep up with mentions and DMs from every network in one inbox, and follow up without losing track.

name: AI agents
blurb: Connect Claude, Codex and other AI agents to your posts and conversations through Mima's local MCP server.

name: Comparisons
blurb: How Mima compares with other ways to manage several social accounts, and when another tool fits better.
